title: Reverse Engineer My App
summary: You built something good and nobody knows it exists. Turn your app, or the page for anything you sell, into a week of posts people actually read: REA maps what your product really does with proof for every feature, and Threadify writes one post per feature in your voice, each with a tracked link to your offer, scheduled after one yes.
triggers: turn my app into a week of build-in-public posts
what should i post about my product
turn my product page into a week of posts

inputs.name: the owner's yes to the ownership question, then the address of a web app they own, their product or offer page, or a pasted feature list, and a connected Threads account

outputs.name: a redacted plain-English feature map with evidence, seven post briefs, one approval card for seven posts with tracked Auto Plugs and a body-free schedule receipt

free_capabilities: ownership gate that stops on anything but yes before any scan
logged-out REA scan of an app the owner owns, in a throwaway browser profile, or a product page or pasted feature list instead
plain-English feature map with REA script, line and column locations or exact quotes, unknowns and limitations, and no server-side claims
redaction of key-like strings, ids and email addresses before anything is shown
seven post briefs with varied angles and a fact check that rejects any feature or number outside the map
casing guard and one approval card that stays blocked until every proof is in
paid_capability_stubs: Threadify post and plug generation counts toward the plan's AI generations
Auto Plug replies need a plan that includes Auto Plug
scheduling uses the connected Threads account

must_show: the app, its map source and feature count
the owner's yes to the ownership question
seven exact posts with their angle, feature, reported model, fact check and casing proof
seven exact Auto Plugs and their destination, or why there are none
seven local times on seven days with their timezone offset

instructions: Stop before any scan unless the owner replies yes to owning the app or having written permission to analyse it.
Without REA, offer npx rea-agents setup from the official rea-agents package (github.com/morluto/rea) only after an explicit yes; otherwise use the owner's product page or a pasted feature list.
Never write or reword a post or plug; Threadify generates them and the only permitted change is lowercasing proved by the casing guard.
Reject and regenerate any post that states a feature or number outside the map, at most three calls per post.
Without a Threadify connection, return the feature map and the seven briefs and say how to connect Threadify.
When Auto Plug is not on the plan, say so and ask whether to schedule without plugs or stop.
On HTTP 402 or a quota error, stop with a plain message.
When a schedule result is unclear, read back with get_schedule_status before any retry.

must_prove: map source, feature count and map hash
fact check and casing guard results per post
schedule readback with Auto Plug echo
